primary_boundary: Resident START through safe RETURN_CPU and token copy. Includes empty-cache prefill and all required metadata, transfers, numerical work and output delivery. Provisioning and independent result checks excluded and separately retained.
checks: Original full-model prompts; exact IDs, complete final logits and valid KV, five selected original story-prefill traces, overflow rejection/non-mutation and successful recovery, safe cleanup and normal helper unload.
scope: Bounded full-request correctness/performance; not 1024 endurance or tail latency. Fixed-context warmup plus three measured samples are separate.
